name: Agent-Usable Controls
description: Checks that interactive controls are operable through the accessibility tree, which is how browsing agents act on a page: buttons have accessible names and are focusable, links have real hrefs, click handlers are not on bare divs/spans, and personal-data inputs declare autocomplete. An icon-only button or an href-less link is invisible as an action to an agent.
inputs: rendered DOM: all <a> elements and their href/aria/name/id/onclick attributes
rendered DOM: div/span/li/p/img/td elements with an inline onclick attribute
rendered DOM: all <input> elements with type, name, id, autocomplete
hidden / aria-hidden="true" attributes on elements and ancestors

scoring.summary: Four categories, 1 point each. Elements inside (or being) [hidden] or [aria-hidden="true"] are ignored. For each category: if it has 0 elements it earns 1 point; otherwise it earns 1 point when Math.round((total - problems) / total * 100) >= 90. If all four categories are empty the check passes with 4 and a 'no interactive controls' message.

rules.condition: buttons: elements = 'button, [role="button"], input[type="submit"], input[type="button"], input[type="reset"], input[type="image"]' not hidden. Problem (max one per element) if no accessible name, OR role="button" on a non-native element (native = button, input, select, textarea, summary, a[href]) without a tabindex attribute
rules.points: +1 if pass rate >= 90% or no buttons

rules.condition: accessible name order: non-blank aria-label; text of elements referenced by aria-labelledby ids; trimmed textContent (includes visually hidden text); title; value attribute; alt attribute; descendant img[alt] with non-blank alt; descendant 'svg > title' text; input type submit/reset with nothing else still counts as named

links: all <a> except role="button" and hidden ones. Problem if href is missing, blank, exactly '#', or starts with 'javascript:' (case-insensitive, trimmed), UNLESS the anchor has aria-haspopup or aria-expanded, OR it is a named anchor (has name or id, has no text content, and has no onclick)
rules.points: +1 if pass rate >= 90% or no links

rules.condition: fakeClickables: 'div[onclick], span[onclick], li[onclick], p[onclick], img[onclick], td[onclick]' that have no role attribute at all and are not hidden. Problem if no tabindex attribute
rules.note: Only literal inline onclick attributes; listeners attached with addEventListener or framework handlers (React onClick, Vue @click, Svelte on:click, Alpine @click) are not visible and never count

rules.condition: autocomplete: <input> elements not hidden. Candidate if type (lowercased, default 'text') is not in ['hidden','password','search','checkbox','radio','submit','button','reset','file','image','range','color'] AND (type is 'email' or 'tel' OR `${name} ${id}` matches /(^|[-_ ])(f(irst)?name|l(ast)?name|fullname|surname|address|street|city|zip|postal|postcode|phone|tel|email|country|state|company|organization)/i). Problem if autocomplete attribute is missing, blank, or 'off'
rules.points: +1 if pass rate >= 90% or no candidates

detect.source_procedure: Prefer scanning built HTML output (dist/, _site/, public/ after hugo, out/ or .next prerendered HTML) with an HTML parser and applying the rules exactly. Without a build, scan markup sources: static *.html; Astro src/**/*.astro (template part after frontmatter); Hugo layouts/**/*.html and shortcodes; Eleventy _includes/** and src/** templates (njk, liquid, md with HTML); Next.js/React app/**, pages/**, components/**/*.tsx|jsx (map JSX: className ignored, aria-label/aria-labelledby/title/alt/tabIndex=tabindex/autoComplete=autocomplete, href; React onClick does NOT render an onclick attribute so do not count it as a fake clickable); Vite SPA index.html plus src/** components. For each file collect buttons, anchors, inline onclick elements, and inputs; skip elements inside hidden or aria-hidden="true" wrappers; compute per-category pass rate per page (or per component when pages cannot be composed) and apply the >= 90% threshold. When labels come from expressions ({t('save')}, {{ .Title }}), treat as named if the expression yields text.

parity.note: The extension sees the live DOM, including controls rendered by client JS, third-party widgets (chat bubbles, cookie banners, embeds) and CMS content, all of which are absent from source. Per-page percentages depend on how components compose into a page, so component-level source scans can differ from the per-URL result. CSS-hidden elements are counted by both (only hidden/aria-hidden are excluded).

fix_summary: Add autocomplete tokens (email, tel, given-name, family-name, street-address, postal-code, country-name, organization) to personal-data inputs; give icon-only buttons aria-label or visually hidden text; replace href-less or '#'/javascript: anchors with <button> or real hrefs; replace div/span onclick with <button> or add role/tabindex. Autocomplete and tabindex are auto-fixable in templates; label wording and link targets need user confirmation.
